description: This file defines the RouteService class, which manages application routing, handles URL manipulation, and observes application events. It extends an abstract service and implements a routing interface.

classes.name: RouteService
classes.description: A service class that manages URL routes, observes application events, and provides routing-related functionality.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the RouteService with application and event bus dependencies, and sets up application event observation.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up the service, removing references and unsubscribing from events.

methods.name: getRoute
methods.description: Returns a new RouteParser instance based on the current window URL.

methods.name: isDotOrg
methods.description: Boolean getter that checks if the current host is 'app.standardnotes.org'.

methods.name: removeQueryParameterFromURL
methods.description: Removes a specified query parameter from the current URL and updates the browser history.

methods.name: addAppEventObserver
methods.description: Sets up an event observer for application events, notably acting on LocalDataLoaded.

methods.name: notifyRouteChange
methods.description: Triggers an event indicating that the route has changed.
